Complete a unit of work

Source: R/glow_run_records.R
glow_unit_complete.Rd

Writes the completion record of a unit and releases its lock. The record is written last and in one move, so a unit that stopped half way has no record.

glow_unit_complete(
  handle,
  outputs = character(0),
  inputs_now = NULL,
  files_now = NULL,
  producer = NULL
)

Arguments

handle

The handle that glow_unit_begin() returned with the status "run".

outputs

Character vector. The files and folders the unit produced. Each has to exist. A folder stands for every file in it at this moment, and the record lists those files, so a file that is deleted later is noticed. Paths inside the unit's folder are recorded relative to it.

inputs_now

NULL, or the inputs dependencies read again at this moment. When they differ from those at the begin, an input was replaced while the unit ran. The function then stops and writes no record.

files_now

NULL, or the files dependencies read again at this moment, compared in the same way.

producer

NULL, or a named character vector that says which process produced the unit, such as c(slurm_job = "1234567"). It is written into the record as it is and is no dependency: a caller that started a job for the unit reads it to tell whether the record is the one that job wrote.

Value

The record that was written, invisibly.

Details

The record gets a generation mark that is new at every run. A part that reads this unit's output stores the mark among its own dependencies, so it finds out when the output is replaced. The two checks at the end catch an input that differs between the begin and the end of the unit. They cannot catch one that was replaced and put back in between. The function also stops when the lock is no longer held under the handle's token.

See also

glow_unit_begin()
